name: @applyingmyself/extension
description: AI-powered cover letter generator Chrome extension

scripts.dev:clean: bun run clean && bun run dev
scripts.dev:hot:clean: bun run clean && bun run dev:hot
scripts.build: WXT_MODE=production wxt clean && WXT_MODE=production wxt build --mode production
scripts.build:dev: WXT_MODE=development wxt clean && WXT_MODE=development wxt build --mode development
scripts.build:staging: WXT_MODE=staging wxt clean && WXT_MODE=staging wxt build --mode staging
scripts.build:prod: WXT_MODE=production wxt clean && WXT_MODE=production wxt build --mode production
scripts.clean: bun -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && wxt clean
scripts.package:webstore: bun run build:prod && bun run zip:prod && bun run validate:webstore
scripts.setup: bun install && bun run build:dev && echo Extension built successfully. Load the dist/ folder in Chrome.
